text:
marie: FYI I'm seeing a bunch of 401s in the Python quickstart sample app when using env var auth. The snippet in docs sets REDWOOD_API_KEY but the SDK expects REDWOOD_KEY (???). Repro steps below.

jon: thanks for flagging — can you paste the snippet?

marie: here: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.generate("Hello")
```
this is straight from https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/python/getting-started (link from the quickstart card)

kevin: oof. Our env var convention changed last quarter when we refactored auth. Docs should use REDWOOD_API_KEY or SDK should accept REDWOOD_API_KEY for backward compat.

docs-bot: automated-link-checker: found 404 -> /sdk/python/examples/async_client.py referenced from quickstart (line ~42).

marie: repro details: container image uses python:3.10, pip install redwood-sdk==0.14.2, then export REDWOOD_API_KEY=xxx; run sample -> 401. If I switch to export REDWOOD_KEY it works.

jon: thanks — this is a parity/compatibility bug. Two possible fixes: (A) docs -> update snippets to REDWOOD_KEY and add migration note, or (B) SDK -> accept both env var names and log a deprecation warning. I lean B to reduce churn.

kevin: agree on B. We had a similar ENV rename in v0.12 and added dual-lookup for a release cycle. If it's a small change I can submit a patch.

marie: also can we fix the async example link? CI link checker failing for external customers following quickstart.

kevin: will open PRs: one to SDK (accept both env names + warn) and one to docs (fix link + update snippet to use the canonical name constant from sdk/examples). PRs will cross-reference.

sre-liaison: tagging because this is causing customer support noise (several incoming tickets). If you go SDK-route B, please add a fallback route that maps REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_KEY, and emit a single warning log line so we can monitor via logs for 1 week before fully removing. Also add a metrics counter (env_var_fallback) so SRE can alert if spike.

jon: noted. I'll add the metrics and warn message text: "[redwood-sdk] using deprecated env var REDWOOD_API_KEY; please migrate to REDWOOD_KEY. This fallback will be removed in v0.16."

kevin: drafting PRs now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/210 (WIP) and https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/134 (WIP). Will include test that sets both envs and asserts the client works and that Client() logs the deprecation warning.

marie: thanks — if you want I can validate the docs link fix in a local mkdocs build before merging. Also please update the quickstart dockerfile in examples so CI doesn't keep shipping a broken sample image.

kevin: will update the Dockerfile too.

docs-bot: link-check: scheduled full re-run in 15m for /sdk/python/getting-started after docs PR merges.

sre-liaison: once PRs are merged, can someone post a short note in #support and the status page that the sample brokenness has been fixed? A few customers were blocked in onboarding.

jon: will do. Also adding a small e2e smoke test to our CI that runs the quickstart container for 10s and verifies no 401s on a simple generate call.

marie: awesome, thanks all. Marking this thread resolved for my part — will reopen if I hit anything else during validation. :thumbsup:
